lesson.text: In any population, individuals vary: some are faster, some better hidden, some better at finding food.
Individuals with helpful traits are more likely to survive and have young, passing those traits on. This is natural selection.
Over many generations, helpful traits become more common. Moths with darker wings became more common where soot darkened the trees.
People use selection too: farmers breed the best cows and crops, choosing which traits carry on (artificial selection).

exercises.prompt: In a population, do all individuals have the same traits?
Individuals with helpful traits are more likely to survive.
What do farmers do in artificial selection?
choices: breed the best animals and plants
exercises.explain: They choose which animals and plants breed.

exercises.prompt: Natural selection happens in a single day.
Soot darkens tree bark. Which moths survive best?
exercises.explain: Dark moths are better hidden on dark bark.

exercises.prompt: Why do helpful traits become more common?
choices: Individuals with them have more young.
exercises.explain: Survivors pass their traits to more young.

exercises.prompt: Which would help a hare survive in snowy lands?
exercises.explain: White fur hides it in snow.

exercises.prompt: Artificial selection is done by people.
Bacteria are treated with a medicine, and a few survive. What might happen?
choices: Survivors breed; the medicine works less.
exercises.explain: Resistant survivors multiply, so the medicine works less well.

exercises.prompt: Giraffes with longer necks reached more leaves in droughts. What happened over generations?
exercises.explain: Long-necked giraffes survived and had more young.

exercises.prompt: Why can't a single animal evolve during its life?
choices: Change happens across generations, not one life.

exercises.prompt: Dog breeds look very different. What made them?
exercises.explain: People bred dogs for chosen traits.

exercises.prompt: A trait that helps in one place might not help in another.
exercises.explain: Yes: it depends on the environment.

exercises.prompt: Order the steps of natural selection.
